# CTR technical-source fixture

- **Primary source:** [Meta Audience Network glossary](https://en-gb.facebook.com/audiencenetwork/resources/glossary)
- **Accessed:** 2026-08-20
- **Observed definition, paraphrased:** the glossary defines click-through rate
  by comparing clicks with impressions and calculates it as clicks divided by
  impressions.
- **Scope:** Meta Audience Network glossary. A production piece must confirm the
  exact Ads Manager metric variant shown in the account, such as all-click CTR
  versus link CTR.
- **Allowed use:** technical definition in education, with the source recorded.
- **Does not prove:** sales, lead quality, revenue, causation, or the performance
  of any Datta/client campaign.

This fixture supports only the metric boundary. Any statement about what
happened after a click remains a hypothesis or requires operational/client data.
